ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between solid black pigmentation and white mottled regions at the tips; approximately 15% high-intensity to 85% low-intensity distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottled clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; the remaining central and proximal regions are characterized by contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression at the center of the upper trailing edge; estimated angle of 125 degrees with a low-depth bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities across the upper trailing edge; visible small peaks and valleys are more pronounced on the outer portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the upper trailing edge, sweeping from the distal tips down toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast white pixel patches localized on the distal extremities of both fluke lobes, corresponding to typical barnacle colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast white mottling and scarring localized at the distal tips of the fluke lobes.
